LESSON: STORY TELLING LISTENING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Story Telling LISTENING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Story Telling LISTENING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use a variety of thematic vocabulary
2. develop an interest in listening to oral stories
3. appreciate their culture and values as taught through oral stories e) empathise with familiar people in stories f) develop their creative and imaginative power as they create mental images of the oral stories home), in pairs and small groups Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners listen to and retell stories. Critical thinking and Problem solving: learners recreate stories Learning to learn: learners listen to stories as narrated by parents and guardians 124 Digital literacy: learners record stories

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use a variety of thematic vocabulary
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use a variety of thematic vocabulary. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. develop an interest in listening to oral stories
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop an interest in listening to oral stories. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate their culture and values as taught through oral stories e) empathise with familiar people in stories f) develop their creative and imaginative power as they create mental images of the oral stories home), in pairs and small groups Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners listen to and retell stories. Critical thinking and Problem solving: learners recreate stories Learning to learn: learners listen to stories as narrated by parents and guardians 124 Digital literacy: learners record stories

Critical thinking and Problem solving: learners recreate stories Learning to learn: learners listen to stories as narrated by parents and guardians 124 Digital literacy: learners record stories. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Story Telling LISTENING.
2. Explain Story Telling LISTENING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Story Telling LISTENING.
4. Show that you can: use a variety of thematic vocabulary
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Story Telling LISTENING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Story Telling LISTENING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use a variety of thematic vocabulary
2. develop an interest in listening to oral stories
3. appreciate their culture and values as taught through oral stories e) empathise with familiar people in stories f) develop their creative and imaginative power as they create mental images of the oral stories home), in pairs and small groups Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners listen to and retell stories. Critical thinking and Problem solving: learners recreate stories Learning to learn: learners listen to stories as narrated by parents and guardians 124 Digital literacy: learners record stories

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
